speaker: David A. Bednar
role: Of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
title: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
summary: Elder Bednar teaches that ordinances and covenants are spiritual credentials for the journey home to God, and that each covenant must be sealed over time by the Holy Spirit of Promise as we repent and stay faithful. He tells of a traveler turned away at a border because he let his valid passport get damaged, then applies the doctrine to temple marriage, separating the lateral sealing of husband and wife from the vertical sealing to God. He assures faithful spouses whose marriages break that another person's choices cannot rob them of any promised blessing, and asks members to keep honoring their covenants.

findings.quote: These blessings are set forth in the covenant received through the marriage sealing ordinance. “While a sealing remains in place, a member who is faithful to temple covenants will receive the personal blessings promised in the temple. This is true even if the person’s spouse has broken the covenants or withdrawn from the marriage. Moreover, God will not require anyone to remain in a sealed relationship throughout eternity against his or her will. Heavenly Father will ensure that each person receives every blessing that his or her desires and choices allow” (General Handbook: Serving in The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, 38.4.1.10, Gospel Library).
findings.note: General Handbook on blessings for a faithful spouse when the other breaks covenants
